capabilities: create decks and cards in the vault
review cards in scheduled repetition sessions
schedule cards with the Anki or FSRS algorithm
open decks from the sidebar or a command
extras: README mentions deck timing and multipliers adjust based on algorithm parameters but does not document them.
intentEvidence: This plugin allows you to have an Anki-like feeling in Obsidian.
motivation: The README says it aims to give 'the ultimate spaced repetition experience' inside Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in flashcard review or spaced repetition, so users who want to memorize material must use a separate app like Anki.

relations.evidence: This plugin allows you to have an Anki-like feeling in Obsidian.

summary: Spaced repetition plugin that adds Anki-style decks and card review to the vault using the Anki and FSRS scheduling algorithms.
